quotes.author: KLFonteno
quotes.text: My husband and I booked a charter with Captain Charlie for the day and we had an absolute blast! He is such a fun, down to earth guy who works VERY HARD to make sure you have the time of your life! Boat was spacious, nice and clean, the meal that he prepared for us was delicious and we enjoyed him playing every single song request.

quotes.author: foxyandpaige
quotes.text: had so much fun with Key Largo Adventures and iRocker Paddle Boards. It was definitely an adventure to remember. Captain Charlie was always there to capture the fun with photos (which we received really fast!) I will surely be recommending him to my friends and can't wait to go out with Key Largo Adventures again!

Another amazing day with Captain Charlie and Claire. We have 4 kids aged 7-15 and everyone had a blast!! Captain Charlie took pictures during the trip and sends them to us - including underwater- can’t wait to see! He was easy to plan with via text and really knowledgeable about fish and the Keys.

quotes.author: Sightseer24463209256
quotes.text: Loved our time with Key Largo Adventures! Captain Charlie provided everything we needed for a fantastic day on the ocean. My husband and I, along with our three kids, had the most memorable day. We loved it and will definitely book another charter the next time we are in the Keys.
